# T-2: Free shipping from $50

Start URL: http://localhost:8091/
Landmark: Your cart

## Acceptance criteria

### Free shipping at exactly $50
Set the quantity of Ceramic mug to 3.
Verify shipping shows Free and the order total shows $50.00.

## Notes

The cart says shipping is free on orders of $50.00 or more. A customer with exactly $50.00 of coffee
in the cart was still charged $5.00 for shipping.
